jobs.description: 공장설립온라인지원시스템(팩토리온) 분양 및 처분신청 공고 (root ADR-0603 §8; scripts/ops/industrial-land-sale-notice-collect.sh factoryon): the widest list (1,567 notices measured 2026-11-22: 한국산업단지공단 and its branches' 처분신청, 시도, 시군, 공사, K-water, 한국농어촌공사, private developers), collected by the owner's decision of 2026-11-22 knowing its robots.txt disallows /bbs/, at the least load: once a day, seven seconds between requests, the whole history once over a few runs, then list page 1 and only the new notices' pages (lttotNdDspsPblancDetail.do) and attachments (atchFileDownload.do). Any 4xx, 429 or a page that is not the one asked for stops the run at once: it commits what it read and fails, so it is seen, and asks nothing more until the next day. Partial: the notices the lakehouse does not record as read with the same list fingerprint (silver.industrial_land_sale_notice_read), newest first, at most per_run_limit and until run_time_budget_seconds, two seconds between requests; the list walk stops at the first page that owes nothing once the reads cover the count the provider states. Each attachment still in use is downloaded and stored once, whatever its format, in the shared content-addressed media store; the details land in Bronze as served, commit_every reads to a content-qualified object (root ADR-0152), each attachment annotated with its hash, format, size, source URL and outcome. Reads nothing inside the files. No Spark.
jobs.memory_measured: no run yet (new 2026-11-22, root ADR-0603); sized as the ILIS notice collector (1G), which keeps one detail and its attachments in memory as this one does, under the same 256 MiB per-file cap (industrial-land-sale-notice.contract.json attachments.max_file_bytes), plus at most one batch of 50 reads (a KICOX post page is about 170 KB, a Factory-on notice page about 60 KB); systemd logs the peak of every run under this cap

first_run.estimated_from: computed from its own bounds: list pages of ten notices and, per owed notice, one page and about 1.5 attachments, seven seconds apart (about 17.5 s a notice), until run_time_budget_seconds of this source (12,600 s) stops the loop and the last notice finishes: about 12,650 s, inside the 12,960 s share of the 240-minute limit; the first fill of 1,567 notices takes two or three daily runs, then one list page a day.

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: The provider publishes notices on no fixed day (endpoint catalog expected_cadence irregular, group industrial_land_sale_notice); that the job runs and finishes is its done expectation (root ADR-0480 §1).

jobs.description: Silver load of the industrial land sale notice reads and attachments (root ADR-0603; scripts/ops/industrial-land-sale-notice-silver-load.sh, the publisher's load-industrial-land-sale-notice-silver, DuckDB inside the publisher and its own Iceberg append, root ADR-0559): the detail objects of the three sources (ILIS, KICOX, LH) that no commit of silver.industrial_land_sale_notice_read records (plan-silver-load-objects, R2 alone), oldest first, each committed on its own: first its attachments in the store to silver.industrial_land_sale_notice_attachment (new or changed (source, notice, hash) only; the index the media reconciler reads the store through), then one read row per notice to silver.industrial_land_sale_notice_read. Both tables are born on their first commit. `unchanged` without starting the load when nothing is owed; no Spark.
jobs.memory_measured: no run yet (new 2026-11-22, root ADR-0603); sized as the ILIS notice Silver load (512M), the same DuckDB stage and append over objects of the same size; systemd logs the peak of every run under this cap

first_run.estimated_from: computed from the ILIS notice Silver load, the same DuckDB stage and append (2.0 s an object measured 2026-11-18 on ai-server over 884 production objects, R2 fetch included): the first fill leaves about 35 objects (741 + 962 notices, 50 to an object), about 70 s, and 600 s stays the bound until a production run is measured, inside the 2,160 s share of the 40-minute limit

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when a collector wrote a notice object; that it is not behind its inputs is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333).

assets.title: 산업용지 분양공고
assets.description: 산업용지 분양·처분·공급 공고와 그 첨부를 네 원천에서 받는다: 공장설립온라인 분양 및 처분신청 공고(가장 넓다, 하루 한 번, 사장 결정), ILIS 분양공고(전국 등록부, 매시), 한국산업단지공단 임대/분양 게시판(공단 자체 단지·임대, 매시), LH 토지 공고(data.go.kr, 활용신청 전까지 꺼짐). 루트 ADR-0603.

assets.title: 산업용지 분양공고 읽은 기록
assets.description: 네 원천의 분양공고 상세를 읽을 때마다(실패 포함) 공고 하나에 한 행을 쌓는다: 원천·공고 id·목록 지문·물은 시각·결과·첨부 수. 수집기가 다음 실행에 물을 공고를 이 표에서 계산한다(루트 ADR-0603).

assets.title: 산업용지 분양공고 첨부
assets.description: 공고마다 그 첨부(PDF·HWP·HWPX·ZIP·그림, 그 밖은 bin)를 내용 해시로 한 번씩 쌓는다: 파일 이름·제공자 id·크기·출처 URL·받은 시각·형식·바이트 수. 바이트는 공용 content-addressed 미디어 저장소에 한 번만 있다(루트 ADR-0298, ADR-0603). 미디어 대조기가 이 색인으로 저장소를 맞춘다.

dependencies.description: 아직 같은 목록 지문으로 읽지 않은 공고의 상세를 새 것부터 묻고 읽은 기록을 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0603).
공고의 첨부를 형식에 상관없이 받아 공용 미디어 저장소에 내용 해시로 한 번만 담고, 색인을 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0603).
수집기가 매 실행 이 표의 마지막 읽음으로 물을 공고를 계산한다: 목록의 공고 중 마지막 읽음이 같은 목록 지문의 read 가 아닌 것, 새 것부터(루트 ADR-0603 §3).
